properties.text: Protective layers with technology that repels oil absorption and prevents stains.
High durability; suitable for a range of applications including high-traffic areas.
Available finishes: matt, gloss and metallic.

collections.summary: SENOSAN acrylic that imitates the look of glass (fan deck 25), with a 2 mm coating including a bevelled edge. Front, edge band and door back are colour-matched.

properties.text: Coating thickness 2 mm including a bevel (polished coating edge for a deep look).
Smooth, uniform, easy to clean, highly resistant to scratches and sun exposure.
Gloss version has strong gloss depth; matt version has very good fingerprint and stain resistance.
Matching front, edge band and door back.

collections.summary: The FANTASY collection mixes SENOSAN acrylic decors with PET decors from RENOLIT (Germany) and HYUNDAI (Korea), featuring metallic tones (pitch-gold, bronze) plus concrete and velvet textures.

properties.text: PET described as recycled and non-PVC; non-reflective, resistant to fingerprints, rubbing and nail scratches, anti-bacterial and colour-stable.
SENOSAN acrylic described as oil-stain repellent, colour-stable, highly scratch resistant, with a seamless edge-to-surface finish.
Applications listed: furniture, decorative cladding, entrance doors.

collections.summary: European oak wood boards dried to 8-12% moisture, offered as Vario (engineered), Lami (solid strips) and Butcher Block. Used for furniture, stairs, worktops, islands, doors and wall cladding.

properties.text: All boards are European oak (imported from Russia), dried to 8%-12% moisture.
Published grading legend: A (Prime/Superior), B (Standard/Natural), C (Rustic/Character).
Vario is described as more stable and less sensitive to the Israeli climate than solid boards; Lami is described as very sensitive to climate changes.

items.itemNote: Engineered board: solid wood strips bonded on both sides of birch plywood.
Solid wood board of glued solid strips.
Solid wood board of rectangular glued pieces; colour variation expected.

collections.summary: RENOLIT polymer (thermofoil) doors, mainly aimed at country/Provence styles, positioned as a quality alternative to paint. The full collection (fan deck 22) is stated to contain about 40 door models, though fewer are listed online.

properties.text: Most doors are built from two MDF layers with routing only in the top layer, giving a smooth surface and stable door.
Bonded with thin, strong polyurethane glue that does not open, avoiding an orange-peel look.
New grooved polymer models for fronts, wall cladding, islands and open units are mentioned.

collections.summary: Flexible decorative CLPL coating from LAMITEX Italy (patented), with decors imitating concrete, stone and veneer-look woods. Supplied in rolls, so it can be laminated onto any board length.

properties.text: Suitable for fronts and for cabinet interiors.
Supplied in rolls; can be bonded to any required length of core board.

collections.summary: A fan of 11 powder-coat colours for Bluran aluminium products (handles, plinths, shutters, shelving units) to match other materials in a Total Design approach.

properties.text: Colouring is done by electrostatic powder coating for full, even coverage and maximum colour match across items.
Applies to aluminium products such as handles, plinths, shutters and shelving units.

collections.summary: Portaline glass for kitchens and furniture in plain, metallic and printed colours with matt or gloss finishes, including extra-clear, satin, tinted antisun, metallic and mirror glass. Handles can be colour-matched to the glass.

properties.text: Applications listed: hinged doors, lift-up flaps, drawer fronts, sliding wardrobe doors, vitrines and decorative wall cladding.
Suitable for large doors, wardrobes and walk-in closets; glass can be painted in any colour or printed with texture.

collections.summary: Core boards onto which finishes (acrylic, HPL, veneer, polymer) are bonded: particle board, plywood (twin/birch), MDF, HDF, CDF and LSB. Choice of core affects durability and suitability for fronts, worktops, cladding and doors.

properties.text: Core boards offered with moisture-resistance and fire-retardant options.
Particle board mainly supplied as P3 grade with MR (moisture resistant); common thickness 8-40 mm.
Plywood (twin and birch) common thickness 4-40 mm; a plywood with 2 mm HDF facing is offered for paint or soft finishes like acrylic and Lamitex.
MDF mainly 740-780 kg/m3 with MR, common thickness 8-40 mm, for fine routing up to 3 mm; CDF 950-1250 kg/m3, 8-20 mm, as a cheaper alternative to compact HPL.
